data.narrative:
Argo Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Robert, Ryan, and Kirby Carlisle that has raised $13.6M to date. The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though direct peer comparables at the seed stage are sparse.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($13.6M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied value of $34M. Peer-median comparison cannot be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the space & aerospace sector (only one narrow peer identified). Public-company anchoring via price-to-sales multiples is not feasible absent the target's revenue figure, though the sector median P/S across six public comps stands at 24.4x, providing potential directional context if revenue becomes available.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $29M (low) to $39M (high), with a median estimate of $34M. This range reflects stage-appropriate mark-up on deployed capital but carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the illiquidity and early-stage risk inherent to seed investing in frontier aerospace. Revenue disclosure or identification of additional seed-stage comparables would strengthen conviction in this range.
